text:
maria: @channel heads-up — seen 5 reports this morning where users briefly lose admin access after SSO refresh. Admin console returns '403 insufficient_permissions'.
ajay: I can reproduce locally. logs show 'role_resolution: no roles found for assertion id=abc123' immediately after SAML reassert.
maria: only happens during silent Okta session refresh. suspect a transient claim expiry in the assertion.
louis: can you paste the raw (PII-sanitized) assertion attributes and the commit that changed parsing? which deploy touched SAML parsing last week?
maria: snippet (attributes only):
```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="roles">
  <saml:AttributeValue>org_admin</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="okta:session_expires">
  <saml:AttributeValue>1690000000</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="okta:transient_claims">
  <saml:AttributeValue>role_bindings=org_admin;exp=2071234570</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```
tia: that 'okta:transient_claims' parsing was added in commit 2b2f7c — we made it authoritative and removed the cache-shortcut.
ajay: reconciliation flow does 'replace roles with assertion.roles' on SSO events. if transient_claim.exp < now (or misparsed) we can end up with an empty role set for that user.
maria: reproducible steps I'm using: 1) sign in 2) wait ~10s for Okta session rotation 3) call GET /admin/org -> 403 for ~20s 4) next assertion processed -> 200
louis: please paste the related logs (mask tokens). this smells like an epoch/float parsing or timezone conversion bug.
ajay: log snippet:
```
[2071234568] role_resolution: assertion_id=abc123 parsed_roles=[] reason=transient_claim_expired parsed_exp=2071234570 now=2071234568
[2071234572] role_resolution: assertion_id=abc123125 parsed_roles=[org_admin]
```
maria: :point_up: note the exp looks slightly ahead but our service time vs parsed value may flip because parser treated exp as relative seconds in one branch.
tia: mitigation plan: revert 2b2f7c to staging, add guard 'if exp <= now then ignore transient_claims' and keep cached roles for session TTL (5m) until a fresh valid assertion arrives.
ajay: I'll prepare a hotfix — change parser from `exp = int(parts['exp'])` to a safer parse and compare against server time, and add unit tests for boundary values.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging hotfix branch sso-transient-fix -> started at 2071234575
maria: also we should emit an audit log whenever we overwrite roles with source=assertion (include assertion_id). creating ticket SEC-4027 and assigning to ajay for hotfix + audit log + tests.
security-bot: SEC-4027 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4027 (owner: ajay) priority: P1 — add audit logs, revert parser, add unit/e2e tests for SSO rotation.
louis: postmortem / followups: 1) add e2e for SAML session rotation 2) instrument metric for short-lived role drops (count + user impact) 3) validate Okta assertion TTL handling across regions (clock skew checks)
maria: rollback to staging is live, running canary against a few internal orgs. will post when prod hotfix is live. thanks all.
ajay: PR + tests incoming, ETA ~2h.
